producer_report.summary: `admit()` in crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs now parses a changed `athena.toml` or `defaults.toml` from the candidate commit. It uses `Config::parse` and `DefaultsModel::parse`, the same parsers the gate uses. A parse failure becomes a `configuration` PolicyViolation with the file path and a detail that gives the parse error and says to repair it. Deleted files are skipped. run.rs already collects these violations, so the job is rejected before landing and run.rs needed no edit. To make the logic testable, I split `admit()` into `admit_without_secrets()` plus the secret scan. Three new tests cover an unknown field in each file, parsing files, and a candidate that touches neither file. I updated the module doc comment and CHANGELOG.md. The full `cargo test --locked` and clippy pass. I ran `cargo fmt --all` last and did not run `cargo fmt --check` afterwards.

checks_run.note: full workspace, all suites ok, 0 failed
applied; no --check run after, but fmt was run last over the code

open_issues: The new tests call a private admit_without_secrets, not admit() itself, because admit() needs the pinned gitleaks binary. The criteria say admit(); a verifier with gitleaks could also run admit(), but the tests do not.
Deliverables content.rs, gate lib.rs and docs/decisions.md were not edited. The gate's landing check stays as it was, and I added no decision entry.
The landing-time exempt-commit rule is not repeated at admission.
mistakes: I first called Edit on CHANGELOG.md with a heading that appears six times; it failed and I retried with more context.
learnings: admit() ends with a gitleaks scan that fails closed when the pinned binary is missing, so a unit test cannot call it without the binary installed.
run.rs already pushes admit()'s violations into candidate.violations, so it needed no edit.
Reading has no test builder usable from admission.rs; the fixture is a struct literal, copied in shape from reading.rs tests.
desires: A way to read the saved output of a long cargo run, since the tool-results path is outside the working directory
